events.body:
## Context

CI only runs `compileall` for blt-vanish; there is no `cloudflare_workers/tests/`. Untested logic includes broker list/by-id/404 (`src/brokers.py`), the 100-per-60s rate limit and content-type check (`src/middleware.py`) and routing (`src/index.py`). The hardcoded `BROKERS` has also drifted from `data/brokers/brokers.json`.

## What to do

1. Add `cloudflare_workers/tests/conftest.py` stubbing the `workers` and `js` modules (copy the approach in `blt-zero/tests/`).
2. Test each module, plus one test that `BROKERS` matches `data/brokers/brokers.json` (sync the data).
3. Change the tests.tsv row to also run `pip install -r requirements-dev.txt && python -m pytest -q`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Broker list/detail/404, 429, OPTIONS and unknown path are covered
- [ ] Data-consistency test passes
- [ ] tests.tsv row runs pytest

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-vanish
```
